note: ORPHAN Pro 18:9 — whoever is slack in his work is brother to a destroyer.

dims.v: negligent sloth — the slack worker as kin to a destroyer
the being slack in one's work — the negligent laziness that, by leaving things undone and neglected, is as ruinous as active destruction, sloth and sabotage reaching the same end
the negligence that wastes and ruins as surely as deliberate destruction

raphah (be slack/let drop) — 'whoever is SLACK in his work is a brother to him who destroys' (18:9); negligence ruins as surely as malice. The one who lets his work fall apart is kin to the one who tears it down. Sloth is a quiet destroyer.
